messages: Reference note: The archive shelves are labeled amber, blue, green, and silver from left to right for this quarter.
Reference note: The lobby plants are watered on Tuesday and Friday, while the upstairs plants are watered on Wednesday.
Reference note: The training room contains twelve chairs, two whiteboards, one lectern, and three unopened marker boxes.
Reference note: The stationery cabinet inventory lists envelopes, folders, clips, labels, tape, and spare notebook paper.
Reference note: The east corridor has four windows, six ceiling lights, and a clock above the fire notice.
Reference note: The cafeteria menu board uses blue lettering for breakfast and green lettering for afternoon service.
Reference note: Meeting rooms Cedar, Maple, and Pine are on the second floor beside the shared supply cupboard.
Reference note: The reception desk keeps visitor badges in numbered trays beside pens, maps, and blank sign-in cards.
Reference note: The internal newsletter uses a square logo, a dark header, and two columns for routine announcements.
Reference note: The storage room contains folded tables, spare cables, empty cartons, and a locked cabinet for projector parts.
Reference note: The courtyard benches face north, while the bicycle rack and delivery entrance sit along the western wall.
Reference note: The office directory lists Finance before Operations and places Facilities immediately after Human Resources.
